what: On hover, the row background fills from left to right (.6s ease), and on release it exits through the right end — a wipe passing in the same direction. With look: line, a 1px underline is drawn and withdrawn along the same path (.4s) · with look: down, it fills top to bottom and exits downward (.35s ease-in-out — news card)

options.--fx-delay: Delay — like the second underline of a two-line text .1s
options.--fx-bleed: Width that widens the background to both sides (negative, e.g. -2.5vw) — for painting wider than the line
options.look: down: Fills from top to bottom and drains downward on release (axis top → bottom) — a card that fills the whole cell
options.look: up: Fills from bottom to top and drains upward on release (axis bottom → top) — news list row (ride-plus-a .5s expo out)
options.look: invert: While the fill rises, the text color also changes to --fx-on (default --kf-bg) over the same length and curve — a white pill VIEW MORE button filling with dark ink (Brand)
options.--fx-on: look: with invert, the text color over the fill (via style), default var(--kf-bg)

use:
News title, one line
· See more
note: The background is painted on ::before (z-index -1, isolation) — if the element’s own ::before is used elsewhere, attach it to an inner span
